PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (10.0, 6.0, 16.0),     # OTA input-pair gm/Id
    "I1":        (6e-6, 2e-6, 20e-6),   # current per input device (tail = 2*I1)
    "gmid_pass": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (tt sizing point)
    "Idiv":      (80e-6, 30e-6, 120e-6),# current in R2 (divider + bleed -> light-load gm_pass)
    "ugf":       (100e3, 30e3, 250e3),  # loop unity-gain frequency target [Hz]
    "Lo":        (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),       # L of OTA mirror/output devices (gain)
    "Vsh":       (0.42, 0.30, 0.55),    # level shift Ish*Rs -> input CM = 0.6+Vsh
}

def _solve_vgs(l, dev, W, L, Id, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.98
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if l.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec["vref"]; iref = spec["iref"]; cl = spec["cl"]
    il_min = spec["iload_min"]; il_max = spec["iload_max"]; vt = spec["vout_target"]
    B = 2.0; I1 = p["I1"]; It = 2 * I1
    Ish = 2e-6; Ipb = 2e-6; Lb = 1.0; Lo = p["Lo"]

    # ---- bias network (all mirrors from IREF) ----
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 12, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt  = lut.size("n", 12, Lb, It,   vds=0.6)
    mnp = lut.size("n", 12, Lb, Ipb,  vds=0.6)
    mpb = lut.size("p", 14, Lb, Ipb,  vds=0.6)
    msh = lut.size("p", 14, Lb, Ish,  vds=0.6)

    # ---- current-mirror OTA ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, I1, vds=0.4, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10, Lo, I1,     vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("p", 10, Lo, B * I1, vds=0.6)
    m7 = lut.size("n", 10, Lo, I1,     vds=0.6)
    m8 = lut.size("n", 10, Lo, B * I1, vds=0.6)

    # ---- pass device: ensure >=1.3*Imax at worst corners with gate at 0.35 V, VIN=1.62 ----
    Lp = 0.15
    op0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, il_max, vds=0.4)
    k = 1.0
    for c, T in [("ss", -40), ("ss", 125), ("tt", 27), ("sf", -40), ("fs", -40)]:
        try:
            l = lut.at(c, T)
            Idw = l.op("p", op0.W, Lp, 1.62 - 0.35, 0.40)["Id"]
            if Idw > 0:
                k = max(k, 1.3 * il_max / Idw)
        except Exception:
            pass
    k = min(k, 4800.0 / op0.W)
    opp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, il_max * k, vds=0.4)
    Wp = opp.W
    mp = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(Wp / 40.0))))
    Cg = opp.cgg

    # ---- divider + level shift ----
    Idiv = p["Idiv"]
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = (vt - vref) / (Idiv - Ish)
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)
    Rs = p["Vsh"] / Ish

    # ---- light-load / heavy-load pass gm (worst corners) ----
    I_light = il_min + (Idiv - Ish)
    gm_l = 1e9
    for c, T in [("ss", 125), ("tt", 27), ("ff", 125)]:
        try:
            l = lut.at(c, T)
            v = _solve_vgs(l, "p", Wp, Lp, I_light, 0.6)
            gm_l = min(gm_l, l.op("p", Wp, Lp, v, 0.6)["gm"])
        except Exception:
            pass
    if gm_l > 1.0:
        gm_l = I_light * 18.0
    try:
        l = lut.at("ss", -40)
        v = _solve_vgs(l, "p", Wp, Lp, il_max, 0.42)
        gm_h = l.op("p", Wp, Lp, v, 0.42)["gm"]
    except Exception:
        gm_h = il_max * 6.0

    # ---- Miller compensation sizing ----
    Gm = m1.gm * B
    ugf = p["ugf"]
    for _ in range(4):
        Cc = Gm * beta / (2 * PI * ugf)
        p2 = gm_l * Cc / ((Cc + Cg) * cl + Cc * Cg)
        if 2 * PI * ugf > p2 / 2.5:
            ugf = p2 / 2.5 / (2 * PI)
    Cc = Gm * beta / (2 * PI * ugf)
    p2 = gm_l * Cc / ((Cc + Cg) * cl + Cc * Cg)
    wz = gm_l / Cc
    wu = 2 * PI * ugf
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wz))

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mn0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("Mt",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mnp", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnp)
    n.dev("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    n.dev("Msa", "a",  "pb", "vin", "vin", msh)
    n.dev("Msb", "b",  "pb", "vin", "vin", msh)
    n.R("Rsa", "a", "vref", Rs)
    n.R("Rsb", "b", "fb", Rs)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "b", "tail", "vss", m1)      # feedback side
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "a", "tail", "vss", m1)      # reference side
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "d2", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "g",  "d1", "vin", "vin", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "x",  "d2", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "x",  "x",  "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "g",  "x",  "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", opp, m=mp)
    n.C("Cc", "g", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = Gm / (m5.gds + m8.gds)
    load_reg = 1.0 / (beta * A1 * gm_h) + 0.3 / (beta * A1 * gm_l) * (gm_l / gm_h)
    iq = iref + Ipb + 2 * Ish + It + I1 + B * I1 + (Idiv - Ish)
    tau = 1.0 / wu
    dv0 = 0.3
    ripple = dv0 * math.exp(-7e-6 / tau)
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 0.3,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "iq": iq,
        "ripple_settled": ripple,
        "phase_margin_deg": pm,
        "ugf_hz": ugf,
        "cc_pF": Cc * 1e12,
        "w_pass_um": Wp,
    }
